title: Medication log
intro: Check off your doses and keep a daily record
emptyBody:
Add a medication once, then
check off each scheduled dose.
future: You cannot log doses for a future date.
past: For a past date, no dose time is recorded.
saveError: Could not save. Your selections are still here.
conflictBody: Review the changes from another session. Reloading replaces unsaved selections here.
discardBody: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
addHeading: How would you like to add it?
addIntro: Check the medication name and prescribed directions.
searchMethodBody: Find a medication by product name
photoMethodBody: Photograph both sides and check the matches
manualMethodBody: Copy the name from your medication label
catalogUnavailable: Medication search is being prepared. You can enter the name manually.
searchNoneBody: Check the spelling or enter the name manually.
duplicateBody: {{name}} is already on your list. Register it separately if the morning and evening doses differ.
editorIntro: Enter the directions you were given
name: Medication name
whenHint: Choose every time you take it
doseHint: Enter the prescribed amount. Do not split pills without instructions.
timingHint: Use the directions from your clinician or pharmacist
reminderHint: Choose the time you take your medicine
editorError: Could not save the medication. Your entries are still here.
registerGuard: Your unsaved dose details will be lost.
savedReminderError: Medicine saved. Some reminders could not be scheduled on this device. Check notification permissions and reminder times.
archiveBody: Future dose lists and reminders will exclude it. Past logs stay unchanged.
pauseBody: This pauses the app schedule and reminders. It does not advise stopping medication.
manageIntro: Manage dose details and reminders in one place
photoIntro: Photograph both sides of one pill
photoHint:
Photograph the letters and numbers in good light.
A photo alone does not identify a medication.
photoConsent: Selected photos are sent to find matches. Keep medication labels and personal details out of the frame.
cameraDenied: Allow camera access to photograph a pill.
photoReadError: Could not open the photo. Choose it again.
recognizing: Checking the details in your photos
recognizingBody: Comparing the imprint and shape with catalog records
recognitionErrorBody: Your photos are still here. Retry or search by name.
noMatchBody: Unclear imprints or similar pills can be hard to distinguish. Search the name on your label.
candidatesBody: Shown in order of similarity · matched against the MFDS drug database
candidateDisclaimer: If unsure, have a pharmacist check the actual pill.
notificationBody: You have a dose scheduled for {{slot}}.
requiredHint: Enter a name, time, amount and unit to continue.
reminderProblemBody: Your medicines are saved. Check your connection and retry scheduling the reminders.
reminderChooseSlot: Select a dose period above first
reminderMealRelation: Choose a time that fits your prescribed meal instructions. Logging a meal does not change the reminder time.
reminderTimeSubtitle: Choose the time you take this dose
reminderBlocked: Notifications are off on this device
reminderPermissionAction: Check notifications and sound in Settings
reminderPermissionRequired: Allow notifications in Settings, or turn reminders off to save the medicine without them.
reminderScheduleNeeded: Set a reminder time for each selected dose period.
reminderCoverageHint: Opening the app extends your schedule. We will remind you before it ends.
reminderCapacity: There is limited notification space on this device
reminderCapacityHint: The nearest reminders are scheduled. Clear other scheduled notifications, then retry.
reminderRenewalBody: Your scheduled reminders end on {{date}}. Open the app to schedule more.
reminderCoverageShortHint: Opening the app extends your schedule. Check the scheduled reminders on your next visit.
poorImage: Couldn't read the imprint in the photo
poorImageBody: Place a single pill inside the frame and retake it in good light, imprint facing up, without glare.
cameraGuide: Place one pill inside the frame and take the photo
cameraGuideSub: Imprint facing up, in good light, without shadows
cameraPurpose: Photos are used only to identify the medication
cameraDeniedBody: Allow camera access in Settings, or search by name instead.
captureError: Couldn't take the photo. Please try again.
candidatesTitleLow: We found similar pills. Please check whether one matches
candidatesHint: AI does not confirm a match. Compare the imprint and shape with the pill in hand and choose only if it matches.
legacy_one: Your {{count}} previous quick dose log is preserved.
legacy_other: Your {{count}} previous quick dose logs are preserved.
pausedOnlyBody: Resume them in Manage medications to check doses by time of day.
bedtimeShifted: It's before 4 AM, so this shows last night's bedtime doses. Change the date to see today.
quotaTitle: Photo checks used up for now
quotaBody: Up to 10 photo checks per hour. Try again later or search by name.
busyBody: Try again in a few seconds.
timeoutTitle: This is taking longer than usual
timeoutBody: A slow connection can cause this. Your photos are still here — try again.
planLimit: You can register up to 40 medications. Archive ones you no longer take.
